main.description: Marks this post as a correction, supplement, or endorsement of a target post. The author of the annotation is the author of this post, not of the target. Anyone may annotate any post.

relation.description: How this post relates to the target.

postReference.description: A reference to a post on one of the two networks. The network field selects which other fields are present: atproto uses uri and optionally cid; nostr uses eventId.

network.description: Network the reference is expressed on.

cid.description: Record CID pinning a specific version of the target. Omit to refer to the location only.

eventId.description: 32-byte Nostr event ID of the target event.
